summary: Enterprise-readiness pass (ComplyEase v3). Extended backend suite to 30 tests (24 prior + 6 new) — all pass on external URL. New coverage: signup short-password (400), login rate-limit lockout after 5 (429), rate-limit counter reset on successful login, POST /auth/change-password (wrong-current 401, short-new 400, correct 200 with login-with-new + revert), PATCH /auth/profile reflected in /auth/me, POST/GET/DELETE evidence with obligation_id filter and audit-log entries. Frontend UI verified for Settings tab (profile update + reload persistence + restore, short-password toast, real change-password + revert) and Register evidence flow (expand → upload → chip → remove). FormHint.jsx and .form-hint CSS confirmed removed. Owner password verified restored to OwnerPass!123 at the end (200 with original, 401 with temp).

issues: Hydration warning in console: <span> cannot be a child of <option> (Register.jsx line ~100 in the FY select). Runtime works but React logs a warning. Consider rendering the option label without the wrapping <span> that the tour/highlight overlay injects, or exclude <option> children from that instrumentation.

action_items: Optional: silence the hydration warning about <span> inside <option> triggered on the Register FY <select>. Not a functional bug but noisy in console.
critical_code_review_comments: Rate limiter is process-local (in-memory dict). Under gunicorn/uvicorn workers > 1 or multi-pod deploys the 5/5min limit becomes per-worker, effectively multiplying the allowance. Document as a single-worker constraint or move to Redis for prod.

update_profile currently strips values where v.strip() is falsy; that silently ignores whitespace-only inputs but also treats empty string as a no-op instead of a validation error. Consider returning 400 when a client sends {'name':''} explicitly.

POST /clients/{cid}/evidence takes obligation_id as a query param (Optional). Consider validating that the referenced obligation belongs to the same client to prevent linking evidence to another tenant's obligation id via a crafted request.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (Settings profile, Settings password change+revert, Register evidence upload+remove)

seed_data_creation: TEST_ auto-cleaned clients and members per test; owner client_limit bumped to 50 for xdist. Owner name may briefly flip to 'TEST Owner UI' during UI test then restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend v3 fully green (30 tests). Rate-limit tests use NON-existent emails to protect the shared owner account. Change-password tests always revert to OwnerPass!123 in a try/finally — if a test crash ever leaves the password on 'OwnerTemp!789', log in with that and PATCH it back. ImportWizard changeTarget/guessMapping JS logic reviewed but not executed via UI (would need multi-sheet xlsx upload); backend imports/preview + apply covered end-to-end in TestImports.
